for(const frame of frames){const e=frame.data;if(frame.kind==="attempt"){pm.expect(e.attempt).to.eql(attempt+1);attempt=e.attempt;parts={};}else if(frame.kind==="delta"){pm.expect(e.attempt).to.eql(attempt);pm.expect(["sms","email"]).to.include(e.channel);pm.expect(e.channel==="sms"?["body"]:["subject","body"]).to.include(e.field);const key=e.channel+"."+e.field;parts[key]=(parts[key]||"")+e.text;deltas++;}else if(frame.kind==="validated"){last=e;finals++;}else throw new Error("Stream failed: "+frame.kind);}

pm.test("Complete selected channels match streamed text",()=>{pm.expect(last.messages).to.have.all.keys("sms","email");pm.expect(last.messages.sms).to.have.all.keys("body");pm.expect(last.messages.email).to.have.all.keys("subject","body");for(const [ch,fields] of Object.entries(last.messages))for(const [field,text] of Object.entries(fields))pm.expect(text).to.eql(parts[ch+"."+field]);});

pm.test("Rendered worst-case limits and allowed placeholders",()=>{for(const [ch,fields] of Object.entries(last.messages)){const b=last.audience.by_channel[ch];for(const [field,text] of Object.entries(fields)){pm.expect(text.trim()).not.to.eql("");const rendered=text.replace(/\{\{(first_name|city)\}\}/g,(_,name)=>"x".repeat(b.count===0?(name==="first_name"?80:120):b[name==="first_name"?"max_first_name_runes":"max_city_runes"]));pm.expect(rendered).not.to.match(/[{}]/);pm.expect(Array.from(rendered).length).to.be.at.most(ch==="sms"?160:field==="subject"?80:2000);}}});

pm.test("Save increments captured generation revision once",()=>{const old=Number(pm.variables.get("staleETag").match(/-r(\d+)"$/)[1]);pm.expect(pm.response.json().revision).to.eql(old+1);});

item.name: Rejected edits preserve content and revision

exec: pm.test("Rejected edits did not change saved state",()=>{const d=pm.response.json();pm.expect(d.revision).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get("savedRevision")));pm.expect(d.messages).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("expectedMessages")));pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("content_ready");});

pm.test("Edited text saved and revalidated",()=>{const d=pm.response.json();pm.expect(d.messages.sms.body).to.eql("Human edited {{first_name}}");pm.expect(d.validation.revision).to.eql(d.revision);pm.expect(d.revision).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get("savedRevision"))+1);});

item.name: Read retained human text after segment change

exec: pm.test("Complete content ready at next revision",()=>{const d=pm.response.json();pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("content_ready");pm.expect(d.validation.revision).to.eql(d.revision);pm.expect(d.messages).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("expectedMessages")));pm.expect(d.validation.audience.as_of).to.match(/Z$/);});

pm.test("Human text retained after segment generation",()=>{const d=pm.response.json();pm.expect(d.messages).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("expectedMessages")));pm.expect(d.validation).to.eql(null);});

item.name: Use stable audience for approval regression

exec: pm.test("Progress exposes no recipient payload",()=>{pm.expect(d).to.have.all.keys("campaign_id","revision","status","approved_at","approved_revision","counts","by_channel");for(const n of [d.counts,...Object.values(d.by_channel)])pm.expect(n).to.have.all.keys("total","pending","in_flight","sent","dead","skipped");});

pm.test("Durable queue and unchanged approval revision",()=>{pm.expect(d.campaign_id).to.eql(a.campaign_id);pm.expect(d.revision).to.eql(a.revision);pm.expect(d.approved_at).to.eql(a.approved_at);pm.expect(d.approved_revision).to.eql(a.approved_revision);pm.expect(d.counts.total).to.eql(a.counts.total);pm.expect(["sending","completed"]).to.include(d.status);for(const n of [d.counts,...Object.values(d.by_channel)])pm.expect(n.pending+n.in_flight+n.sent+n.dead+n.skipped).to.eql(n.total);});
